news.title: On-device AI agents hit a hard memory limit. Apple's new architecture routes around it.
news.summary_raw: On-device AI models have stayed small because the entire weight set has to live in DRAM, capping practical parameter counts well below what server-side deployments use. Enterprise architects evaluating agentic workloads have had to choose between capable cloud-dependent models and limited on-device ones. Apple's third-generation foundation models, announced at WWDC26, break that constraint by moving the weight set off DRAM entirely.The AFM 3 family was developed in collaboration with Google
news.summary: Apple has announced its third-generation Apple Foundation Model (AFM) architecture, which allows on-device AI models to bypass memory limits. This development helps enterprise architects balance capable agentic workloads with device constraints.
news.enterprise_use: This news may not have a direct impact on your daily IT management, but it could influence your organization's approach to on-device AI development, especially with Apple's growing influence in the enterprise. However, the immediate action points for you remain unchanged, focusing on optimizing AI usage within your current stack.
